text: S4: sync engine core (field-level LWW, pure service)

Design note: S1 partial-unique live-name index forbids two live same-name items, so name-merge cannot be a pure post-apply scan of committed rows. Collisions are caught as IntegrityError in apply_changes and merged inline via _merge_group; name_merge(conn,list_id) is the idempotent per-list safety net S5 should still call. Also removed the commit from db.next_change_seq (T-1) so apply+merge+delta stay in one transaction for S5.
